description: Creates the IO system of a PROFINET controller interface; connect the IO devices to it afterwards with tia_io_system_connect. `controllerInterface` is the interface item name from tia_device_network (default: the primary network interface). `name` and `number` are optional (left out, TIA chooses); a number outside 100-115 is 400 invalid_io_system_number and one another IO system already has is 409 io_system_number_in_use (details.usedBy); when a number is passed and the IO systems of a subnet could not be listed it is 409 subnet_inventory_incomplete (details.gaps). Also refused, nothing changed: 409 not_io_controller, 409 interface_not_connected (connect the interface to a subnet with tia_network_connect first), 409 io_system_exists (details.ioSystem: the controller already has one, use tia_io_system_update), 404 not_found. The result carries `ioSystem` {name, number, subnet} and a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads the IO system after the write); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches): re-read with tia_io_systems before retrying. 409 io_system_create_incomplete (details.error, details.cleanupError, details.ioSystemRemains): setting the number failed and removing the new IO system did not verify, so the project may be partially changed and an IO system may be left on the controller: re-read with tia_io_systems before retrying. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns the plan WITHOUT creating anything. Maps to POST /iosystems. M-off.

controllerInterface.description: controller interface item name, as listed by tia_device_network (default: the primary network interface)

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

name.description: IO system name (default: chosen by TIA)

number.description: IO system number, 100-115 (default: chosen by TIA)

name: tia_io_system_create
